001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory;
002
003import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
005
006/**
007 * InventoryWrapper for countable Inventory
008 */
009public interface CountableInventoryWrapper extends InventoryWrapper {
010
011  /**
012   * Counting the items
013   *
014   * @param predicate {@link ItemPredicate}
015   *
016   * @return the items
017   */
018  int countItem(@NotNull ItemPredicate predicate);
019
020  /**
021   * Counts items while also exposing the immutable template requested by QuickShop.
022   *
023   * <p>Specialized virtual inventories may need the template to calculate exact compatibility.
024   * Existing wrappers retain their predicate-only behavior.</p>
025   *
026   * @param template the requested item template
027   * @param predicate the configured item matcher
028   * @return the matching item count
029   */
030  default int countItem(@NotNull final ItemStack template, @NotNull final ItemPredicate predicate) {
031
032    return countItem(predicate);
033  }
034
035  /**
036   * Counting the spaces
037   *
038   * @param predicate {@link ItemPredicate}
039   *
040   * @return the space
041   */
042  int countSpace(@NotNull ItemPredicate predicate);
043
044  /**
045   * Counts capacity while also exposing the immutable template requested by QuickShop.
046   *
047   * @param template the item QuickShop intends to insert
048   * @param predicate the configured item matcher
049   * @return the available capacity
050   */
051  default int countSpace(@NotNull final ItemStack template, @NotNull final ItemPredicate predicate) {
052
053    return countSpace(predicate);
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * The item predicate for calculating
058   */
059  interface ItemPredicate {
060
061    /**
062     * Check if the item match the predicate
063     *
064     * @param input the item want to check
065     *
066     * @return if the item match the predicate
067     */
068    boolean isMatch(@NotNull ItemStack input);
069  }
070}
